summary: Phase 14 — Public Sandbox Tour at /tour + Slack live. 7/7 Phase 14 backend tests pass + 34/34 regression tests pass (Phase 11+12+13) = 41/41 total. Frontend verification of /tour confirms full data-testid coverage (tour-page, hero badge/start/cta, header CTA, all 6 step sections, sticky preview panel + 6 preview kinds, final book/pricing CTAs). Scrollytelling preview-swap verified by scrolling into step sections and observing the preview testid change (e.g., scrolling into tour-step-slack swaps preview to tour-preview-slack). Header 'See it live' nav link present on homepage and navigates to /tour correctly. Public snapshot endpoint returns 200 with no auth, auto-seeds after wipe, returns >=4 escalations and 2 milestones, strips hashed_password/raw_data, every client_email ends in @bloomlabs.demo. Slack /test endpoint returns ok+green pill. Sitemap includes /tour with priority 0.95.
critical_code_review_comments: public_tour_routes.py — Clean separation: _ensure_seeded triggers demo_routes._seed only when count<4 (idempotent + safe). _public_safe strips hashed_password/raw_data and serializes to JSON-safe via serialize_doc. {_id:0} projection at query time is the right belt-and-suspenders pattern (cannot leak ObjectId).

PublicSandboxTour.jsx — IntersectionObserver rootMargin '-40% 0px -55% 0px' is a sensible narrow band that crisply switches active step as the user scrolls. Sticky preview panel uses `lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start lg:h-[calc(100vh-7rem)]` correctly anchoring on desktop. GA4 events `tour_step_view` (per observer intersection) and `tour_cta_click` (header/hero/footer) are wired with the right `typeof window.gtag === 'function'` guard.
Page is fully public — no auth context dependency, no admin token leakage. SeoHead included with canonical https://bybloomlabs.com/tour. Sitemap entry added.
Header.jsx NAV_ITEMS array now contains { id: 'tour', label: 'See it live', type: 'route', to: '/tour' } — clicking on homepage navigates to /tour via react-router (verified in Playwright run).

Minor observation (not a bug): The IntersectionObserver behavior depends on viewport height — at a 4000px test viewport the 40-45% visibility band lands in the middle step section at scroll=0, so the 'initial' active step in a tall viewport is not step 0. In a realistic user viewport (~900-1080px) at scroll=0 the band is over the hero region and active stays at 0 (onboarding). Acceptable production behavior; no fix needed.
Slack live wiring verified — admin/integrations/slack/test endpoint returned 200 with green pill in the integrations health response.
